subject.title: fix(kilocode): discover models when HTTP proxy is required

question: Should KiloCode retain this focused owner-local proxy opt-in, or should its fix be incorporated solely through the broader shared catalog-runtime work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/112439?
rationale: Both open PRs explicitly cover KiloCode proxy discovery but propose different implementation boundaries; selecting the durable owner boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the focused KiloCode repair
options.body: Keep the provider-local preset wrapper after the contributor supplies redacted real proxy and NO_PROXY/direct proof, then exclude KiloCode from the broader refactor.

options.title: Fold it into the provider sweep
options.body: Close or supersede this narrow branch only after the broader PR preserves KiloCode’s fallback, response-release, and proxy behavior with equivalent proof.

recommendation.title: Land the focused KiloCode repair
recommendation.body: Keep the provider-local preset wrapper after the contributor supplies redacted real proxy and NO_PROXY/direct proof, then exclude KiloCode from the broader refactor.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline assigns this PR to steipete and connects them to the related provider-proxy implementation sequence.
